# Sub 5: External-user configurability audit (forks, npx neo-app workspaces, non-Neo-team clients)

## Parent Epic

neomjs/neo#11831 — **Sub 5 of 6 (parallel after Sub 1).**

## Scope

Audit the Orchestrator + daemon substrate for Neo-team-specific assumptions that don't survive external deployments (repo forks, `npx neo-app` workspaces, cloud tenants). Sister concern to ADR 0014 cloud-deployment-topology profile-default precedent.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **Hardcoded Neo-team identities/paths audited:** no `@neo-opus-ada` / `@neo-gpt` / `@neo-gemini-pro` literal references in daemon code (only in `ai/graph/identityRoots.mjs` registry).
2. **Project ID assumptions:** no hardcoded "Project 12" / "v13" / `release:v*` label-as-project-proxy patterns (use `aiConfig.currentReleaseProject` or substrate resolver).
3. **Path assumptions:** all paths resolve relative to checkout root via existing Neo path helpers, never hardcoded to operator's local checkout (`/Users/Shared/github/neomjs/neo/`).
4. **Local-vs-cloud profile distinction:** all daemons honor `aiConfig.deploymentProfile` (or equivalent) per ADR 0014. Cloud profile disables features that require local Neo-team substrate (e.g., heartbeat-target-list resolution per Discussion #11823 / Epic neomjs/neo-agent-brain#148 AC2).
5. **`npx neo-app` workspace safety:** running daemons from a fresh `npx neo-app` workspace must not error on missing Neo-team substrate (identityRoots entries, etc.); features that require it MUST disable cleanly with a clear log.

## Sister concerns

- Epic neomjs/neo-agent-brain#148 (wake-driver substrate) Sub 1 (`resolveSwarmHeartbeatTargets()`) — same external-portability discipline applied to wake-driver
- ADR 0014 cloud-deployment-topology profile-default precedent

**Authored by:** [Claude Opus 4.7] (Claude Code)

> ❋ ## External-user configurability audit — findings (grep sweep of `ai/daemons/**` + `ai/services/**`)
> 
> ### AC1 — hardcoded Neo-team identities in logic
> 
> | Site | Finding | Severity |
> |---|---|---|
> | `ai/services/ingestion/IssueIngestor.mjs:194` | **`if (meta.author && meta.author !== 'tobiu')`** — the "Community Multiplier" hardcodes the neomjs operator login as the internal-vs-community proxy. In any external deployment (fork / `npx neo-app` / non-neomjs cloud tenant) there is no `'tobiu'`, so **every** ticket is mis-classified as community-external and gets the `+0.5` weight boost — the multiplier's semantic inverts. **NEW finding → config-gap ticket filed.** | **Real (logic break)** |
> | `ai/services/graph/GoldenPathSynthesizer.mjs:456` (`agentLogins`) + the `CORE_SWARM_AGENT_FAMILIES` / `DEFAULT_STALE_ASSIGNMENT_MAINTAINERS` constants added by PR neomjs/neo#12125 | Hardcoded swarm logins; client-gated behind `repoEnrichmentEnabled` (disabled in cloud deployments) so non-breaking, but the consolidation-to-`identityRoots.mjs` is owed. | Already tracked → **#12126** (GPT) |
> | `WakeDecisionService.mjs:111`, `KbAlertRuleEngine.mjs:78`, `WakeSubscriptionService.mjs:71-72`, `GraphService.mjs:1117` | `@neo-*` appear only in **JSDoc comments / examples / archaeology refs** — not branch logic. Genericizing is decay-prone-archaeology cleanup (cf. neomjs/neo#11912 epic), not an external-deployment break. | Low (comment-only) |
> 
> ### AC2 — Project-12 / v13 / `release:v*` assumptions
> **PASS.** The only `release:v*` hits (`IssueService.mjs:458,688`, `mutations.mjs:391`) are in JSDoc comments *documenting the deprecation* ("substrate-correct replacement for the deprecated `release:v*` pattern"). No hardcoded Project-12/v13 logic in daemon/service code.
> 
> ### AC3 — hardcoded local-checkout paths
> **PASS.** Zero `/Users/Shared` or `/Users/*/github` references in `ai/daemons/**` or `ai/services/**`. Paths resolve via Neo path helpers.
> 
> ### AC4 — local-vs-cloud profile distinction (ADR 0014)
> **PASS (substantial).** The orchestrator honors `AiConfig.orchestrator.deploymentMode === 'cloud'` (`Orchestrator.mjs:113` / `:128`); `tenantRepoSync.mjs` gates its lane on it. Cloud-profile lane-disabling is wired.
> 
> ### Verdict
> 
> The substrate is **largely external-deployment-clean** — AC2/AC3/AC4 pass. The one genuine logic break is **`IssueIngestor.mjs:194`'s hardcoded `'tobiu'`** (filing as a config-gap ticket: the internal-author set should resolve from config / `identityRoots.mjs` maintainers, not a literal). The identity comment-mentions are low-priority genericization (fold into the neomjs/neo#11912 archaeology-cleanup epic if desired). GoldenPathSynthesizer is already → neomjs/neo#12126.
>
